final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS c FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM s1) SELECT s1.k, s1.c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.total FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL AND s2.total <> 0
